correctness.rationale: The Weyl basis diagonalizes the full orbit-projector normal map, with λ=q²(sum of the two squared ambiguity functions). Each shifted parabola intersects its translate in zero, one, or q points as dictated by a linear equation; at shift zero, odd-characteristic Gauss orthogonality gives exactly the listed squared magnitudes. Summing five exhaustive cases yields q⁴ eigenvalues, all positive, with sharp endpoints 1 and 2q². The one-window rank and at-most-q difference-set obstruction follow directly. Independent direct finite calculations of the ambiguity and lifted Gram spectra at q=3,5 plus extension q=9 test normalization but are not the proof.
